name: 27-sell-markup-sl-at-account-ask
why: Owner decision 2026-09-26: a SELL closes (and its SL triggers) at the account's marked-up ask. BrokerSymbol.spreadMarkup 1.5 pips on XAUUSD: raw ask 4299.13 is below the SL 4299.25, the account ask 4299.28 is above it, so the SL fires and closes at 4299.28 (-928). Needs scripts/parity/run-ts.ts to seed BrokerSymbol.spreadMarkup from symbols[].spreadMarkup.
